_verification.note: Drug #2, added to stress-test the schema (discontinuation branch + a metric whose value collapsed on confirmation). Claude-drafted from web sources. Human spot-check pending. Approximate dates (IND Q1 2012, NDA mid-2015) and trial NCT numbers (esp. TIGER-3) still to confirm.

identity.name: Rociletinib
indications: EGFR T790M-mutated advanced/metastatic NSCLC, after prior EGFR TKI

trials.name: TIGER-X (CO-1686-008)
trials.note: Pivotal single-arm Phase 1/2. The trial whose ORR fell from ~60% (unconfirmed) to 28% (confirmed) on FDA-requested review.

trials.name: TIGER-3 (CO-1686-020)
trials.note: Confirmatory randomized Phase 3 vs chemotherapy. Enrollment terminated May 2016 before any efficacy readout — the trial ODAC wanted to see before deciding. NCT to confirm.

timeline.note: IND accepted Q1 2012; Phase 1/2 TIGER-X initiated (approximate).
FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation for T790M NSCLC after progression on prior EGFR TKI.
Rolling NDA for accelerated approval submitted mid-2015 (completed ~Nov 2015), on pooled single-arm TIGER-X + TIGER-2 data.
ODAC voted 12-1 against accelerated approval after updated data showed markedly lower confirmed response rates; panel wanted Phase 3 TIGER-3 results first.
Clovis terminated enrollment in all rociletinib trials (incl. Phase 3 TIGER-3) after FDA signaled a Complete Response Letter; competitor osimertinib had been approved in the same setting.

efficacy.definition: Response rate including unconfirmed responses, 500 mg dose, n=48 (ASCO 2015).
efficacy.note: Initially reported figure that generated the excitement — later revised sharply downward.

efficacy.definition: Confirmed responses only, 500 mg dose, after FDA-requested review (625 mg arm: 34%).
efficacy.note: The collapse: ~60% → 28% on confirmation. This revision drove the ODAC 12-1 rejection and the program's end. Same endpoint name as the row above, DIFFERENT definition — hence comparable:false.

discontinuation.reason: Confirmed ORR fell far below initially reported figures; ODAC voted 12-1 against accelerated approval; FDA signaled a Complete Response Letter; competitor osimertinib approved in the same setting.
